company.name: Holo
company.shortDescription: Holo is an end to end property buying platform that supports mortgage search, comparison, and application.
company.description: Holo is a digital property buying platform, transforming the homebuying process with an integrated, end-to-end digital solution. It provides personalized home loan consultancy and enables users to browse a comprehensive selection of mortgage offerings, including conventional and Sharia-compliant options, guiding them through financing with tools like eligibility checks, calculators, and application tracking. It also offers a white-label solution for real estate partners to embed real-time mortgage advisory into their platforms.

productsAndServices.description: A mortgage comparison and application service that matches UAE homebuyers with lender products and supports eligibility checks, document submission, applications, and approval tracking.
productsAndServices.name: UAE Mortgage Brokerage and Application Platform

productsAndServices.description: A buyer-side property advisory service that helps customers search for properties, compare options, assess value, coordinate viewings, and manage the purchase through completion.

productsAndServices.description: A Sharia-compliant property financing service offering structures such as Ijara, Murabaha, and Musharaka through Islamic financial partners in the UAE.
productsAndServices.name: Islamic Home Financing

productsAndServices.description: A mortgage advisory and brokerage service for expatriates financing UK residential or buy-to-let property, including applications involving foreign income and refinancing.
productsAndServices.name: UK Mortgages for Expats

productsAndServices.description: A commercial property finance brokerage service for businesses purchasing, refinancing, or developing offices, retail units, warehouses, labour camps, land, and construction projects.
productsAndServices.name: Commercial Mortgages and Corporate Financing

productsAndServices.description: A property legal-transfer coordination service covering contracts, title checks, deposit handling, registration requirements, No Objection Certificates, and ownership transfers in Dubai.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $22,000,000, or 95.65% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,116,459 to $110,787,221, a 35.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
